The 138.8° elbow flexion and 155.1° knee flexion further demonstrate a balanced, proactive stance that balances offense and defense, crucial for scoring in Freestyle Wrestling's point-based system. Despite the risk of relying solely on reflexes, Maher's technique emphasizes a blend of positioning and movement that maximizes scoring opportunities while mitigating the inherent risks of Freestyle Wrestling.
